description: This file defines a custom exception class 'PerformanceTrackerServiceException' within the 'OrangeHRM\Performance\Exception' namespace. The class provides a static method to generate a specific exception message related to editing an employee with existing performance logs.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, used for handling errors related to the Performance Tracker Service in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: cannotEditEmployeeWithLogs
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an instance of PerformanceTrackerServiceException with a specific message indicating that an employee cannot be updated due to existing performance review logs.
